text: SUPERVISOR — USER VERDICT on WALLTOP-0606: FAIL. This is live, post-rebuild, with your fix in the running bundle. Your regression test claimed no input or state can produce the old side placement — the user just produced it by placing a wall normally. Your test asserted upstream of the live placement path: find the OTHER code path that still computes the side anchor (a second placement route, a ghost-preview-to-commit divergence, or a snap branch you missed) — there is at least one more, and your test does not cover it. Reproduce the user's live result first (place a wall in the running app or its headless witness, show the side-anchored y in the placed data), then collapse that path into the single top anchor and extend the test to cover the path the user actually hit. Post the file:line of the path you missed.
